static_traits.name: Lin Kai
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive friends and family, but not yet talked to them about academic Fear; Alienated from friends and classmates due to embarrassment over failure
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; not yet received psychotherapy; no similar problems have emerged before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic, able to self-observe and describe thoughts and emotions, highly cooperative; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Strong Anxiety and Fear of failure after getting an F on a recent history quiz, firmly believing I will fail history for the rest of the year, leading to reduced focus and Learning ability plus procrastination.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping counseling will ease the Fear of failure, reduce Anxiety's negative impact on academic performance and mental health, improve the sense of control over Learning, and stop letting Anxiety dominate Learning and life.

core_beliefs: I am not good at history
No matter how hard I try, I cannot understand history

special_situations.event: Recalling the F grade after a history quiz
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail one important quiz, it means I am overall not good at history and will keep failing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles study efforts and asks classmates for help to prove they can improve
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This F confirms my worst fears; I will fail for the whole year

special_situations.event: Thinking about studying history or preparing for the next assessment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot fully understand the Learning material, I will definitely fail again and feel even more embarrassed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinating and avoiding actual Learning to temporarily ease Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter how hard I study, I will still fail

special_situations.event: Thinking about receiving feedback from the teacher or the course
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the feedback is not ideal, it means I am not good at history
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces communication with teachers and classmates, avoiding discussion of past grades to evade embarrassment

special_situations.event: Focuses only on this failure when reviewing overall performance in history class
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Failure says more about the problem than past successes in assignments and quizzes
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly recalls failure experiences, ignoring past successful experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This failure shows I am just not good enough overall

core_conflict.wish: Longing to regain control and confidence over academics, reducing Anxiety and stabilizing history class performance
core_conflict.fear: Fears failing again and feels embarrassed and ashamed because of it
defense_goal: Lowering shame and tension by Avoids socializing feedback
Doubles study efforts to prevent failing again and gain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A Student not good at history, prone to failure and embarrassment
object_relations.object_representation: Teachers/classmates are evaluators whose feedback may expose my inadequacy

manifestations: Alienated from friends and classmates due to embarrassment over failure
Not yet talked about academic Fear even with the support system (family and friends)

exception_events.target_problem: Before history Learning or assessments, the client typically becomes severely Anxious for fear of failure, develops 'bound to fail' thoughts, and procrastinates, affecting preparation and grades
exception_events.unique_outcome: Previously achieved better results in some history homework and quizzes, and experienced moments of relatively greater grasp and confidence
exception_events.reason: Clues: the task difficulty was more manageable, understanding of the material clearer, or help and Clarification from others was received, so preparation was fuller, Anxiety lower, and engagement in completing the task possible

positive_force: Has a certain degree of study engagement and tendency to work hard (trying to study doubly hard)
Willing to seek classmates' help and clarification
Has had successful experiences in some assignments and quizzes before
Positive attitude toward counseling; willing to practice and try new methods
negative_force: Strong fear of failure and embarrassment
Overgeneralization and predicting the future (inferring long-term failure from one failure)
Study procrastination and avoidance behaviors maintain the problem
Sleep disturbed, further weakening Learning efficiency and emotion regulation

target_behavior.behavior: Procrastination and avoidance in history Learning (with strong Anxiety and catastrophic predictions)
antecedent: Thinking about studying history or preparing for assessments
Recalling getting an F on the last history quiz
Anticipation receiving teacher or course feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one quiz failure into long-term failure, with negative predictions (I will keep failing), producing strong Anxiety and shame, leading to avoidance and procrastination
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the possibility of failure and embarrassment, short-term Anxiety relief
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient Learning preparation, declining grades, persistent and worsening Anxiety, Sleep disturbance, and drifting from classmates and friends
